title: Smart Scheduling
description: Offer open times in a text conversation and let customers book, confirm and get reminded without leaving the thread.
intro: Smart Scheduling lets your customers book a meeting without leaving the text conversation. You offer open times from your team's connected calendars, the customer picks one by replying, and the meeting is created, confirmed and reminded automatically.

blocks.p: Before you offer times, connect at least one calendar so Smart Scheduling knows when your team is free.

steps: Connect a Google or Microsoft calendar for each rep who takes meetings.
Set your **working hours**, **buffer time** and **meeting length**.
Turn on **round-robin** to assign each meeting to the next available rep.

blocks.alt: Scheduling settings with connected calendars, working hours and a round-robin toggle

sections.heading: Offer open times in a conversation

steps: Open the conversation and click **Suggest times** in the composer.
A card with three open slots, such as Tue 10:00 AM, Tue 2:30 PM and Wed 9:00 AM, is inserted into your reply.
Send the reply. The customer answers with the slot number (for example "2") or taps a slot.

blocks.alt: The message composer with Suggest times inserting three time slots into a reply

blocks.note: The AI assistant can offer times too, using the same calendars and rules.

blocks.p: When the customer picks a slot, the meeting is created and a confirmation message is sent. Reminders go out automatically **24 hours** and **1 hour** before the meeting.
Each meeting shows one of these statuses:

head: Status
Meaning
rows: The customer picked a slot and the meeting is on the calendar.
The meeting was moved to a new time.

blocks.alt: A list of upcoming meetings with Booked and Reminded statuses and a reminder preview

blocks.p: Each inbox can have its own meeting types, availability and the questions asked before booking.

bullets: **Meeting types**: for example Demo (30 min) or Onboarding (45 min).
**Availability**: the hours this inbox offers meetings.
**Pre-booking questions**: what to ask the customer before the meeting is booked.

blocks.alt: Inbox booking rules showing Demo and Onboarding meeting types with durations

blocks.p: Customers will be able to reply "reschedule" to get new times.

faq.q: Who gets the meeting when several reps are available?
faq.a: With round-robin on, the meeting goes to the next available rep.
Smart Scheduling is live for all plans.
